√tak 'rush'
present: [2.] takti atakta -- [1.] takati 
[perfect: tatāka atakīt atākīt takiṣyati takitā ]
verbal: taktá -táṅkam 
derivatives: -takana táku RV. tákavāna RV. -takri? RV. takvá RV. tákvan V.B. -tákvarī AV. 
Probably not to be separated from √tac, which with prefix ā has won a special meaning.
